items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: Ross McConnell. Uh, hmm. Booking agent. Uh, hmm. Well, Ross McConnell was pretty smooth guy.

ctx.x: Oh, we didn't talk about Joe Oliver, King Oliver, when you got up, got up there with him. Uh, did he have trouble collecting this money ever, or was he making a lot of money?

Uh, when I joined him, I joined him in Hopkinsfield, Kentucky. Uh, hmm. That's where I met the band. Uh, hmm. They had, had that problem with that band, that, that bus burning up in Hopkins, Uh, hmm. And, he had a booking agent, uh, whose headquarters at home was right then, Hopkinsfield, Kentucky. Uh, hmm. Uh, hmm. Ross McConnell. Uh, hmm. Booking agent. Uh, hmm. Well, Ross McConnell was pretty smooth guy. Uh, hmm. He knew how to count. One for you and a hundred for me. Uh, hmm. He knew how to count. He was a…
She told me later. Stella, you're talking about. Stella, yeah. She got some money later and I think Joe Glazer helped her. Good.
